At International College Spain (ICS) in Madrid, we’ll inspire your child to go further. Following our world-renowned International Baccalaureate programmes – which we’ve taught for more than 45 years – our students achieve amazing academic success, which opens doors to the world’s best universities. Your child will grow into a confident and well-rounded global citizen, too, nurtured by exceptional teachers and empowered by our warm, caring community.
Our values of Excellence, Respect and Service are at the heart of everything we do. They shape our classrooms, our relationships and the culture of our school.
SUCCESS THROUGH THE iNTERNATIONAL BACCALAUREATE PROGRAMME

At International College Spain, Madrid, your child will enjoy a truly exceptional academic education that will inspire them to achieve more than they ever thought possible. We’re proud to offer all three prestigious International Baccalaureate (IB) Programmes in English for students aged 3 to 18. Perfected over more than 45 years, our curriculum is enriched with personalised learning experiences that nurture every student’s passions, while our exclusive global collaborations with MIT, UNICEF, and The Juilliard School cultivate creativity, critical thinking, and cultural awareness. As well as inspiring a lifelong love of learning, our approach leads to consistently outstanding academic outcomes . Our students’ average IB Diploma score is well above the global average, with more than 10% achieving an exceptional 40 points or higher. ICS graduates go on to attend some of the world’s top-ranked universities
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE
Our globally respected curricula – created by world-leading education experts – reimagines learning through our six core pillars.

Your child will love learning at International College Spain. On our creative, challenging, and truly global International Baccalaureate programme, our students achieve remarkable academic, personal, social, and emotional success.

Caring, inspirational, and fully committed to your child’s all-round development, our teachers are among the best in the world. They bring a wealth of international experience and qualifications to our classrooms, and transform learning in extraordinary ways.

Ideally located in a quiet residential community, only 10 minutes from the centre of Madrid, our campus has everything your child needs to learn, discover, and grow. ICS is surrounded by ample green areas, fantastic sports facilities, and energising creative spaces that will inspire our students to achieve great things.

The global education we offer at International College Spain extends far beyond the classroom. Through a myriad of outstanding learning experiences – from international trips to sports tournaments, the arts, and STEAM – your child will develop the skills and knowledge they need for the future.

ICS is an international school in the truest sense. Home to students, parents, and staff from more than 70 countries, we’re a vibrant community where everyone is welcome. We’re also connected to Nord Anglia Education schools worldwide, creating extraordinary opportunities across the globe.

Our students care about the world and want to change it for the better. At ICS, your child will embrace our culture of helping others and make a real difference in school, the local community, and across the globe.
JOIN THE CARING ICS MADRID COMMUNITY

We’re delighted you’re considering International College Spain (ICS), for your child’s education. You’ll receive a warm welcome from our friendly admissions team, who will answer all your questions and guide you through our application process.
Get in touch with us today – fill in our online enquiry form, email, or call us.
Come and see us in Madrid – or join us for a personalised virtual discovery meeting.
Send us your application (we accept new students all year round).
We’ll invite your child to an assessment.
After successfully completing their assessment, we’ll offer your child a place.

pages.title: Social Purpose | International College Spain
blocks: Our outward-looking international community inspires action, as students, staff, and families come together to make a real difference. Your child will embrace our commitment to helping others, supporting great causes here and across the globe.

We’re proud to be a key part of our community, La Moraleja. Our students form meaningful local connections and make a real difference by taking part in litter clean-ups, tree-planting projects, and Earth Day celebrations. Working alongside other children and families, our students see the importance of taking collective action to create a more sustainable world.

Students use their determination, empathy, and skills in support of local good causes, too. They collect essentials for families in need, support a local pet rescue shelter, and raise funds to buy sleeping bags for people without a home. In doing so, they see the positive impact they can have – and discover their role as changemakers in our society.

Our diverse school community inspires our students to celebrate difference and embrace internationalism. Activities marking Mother Language Day, International Children’s Day, International Religions Day, Hannukah, Diwali, and Chinese New Year, for example, give our students an appreciation of different traditions and customs, as well as instilling a global mindset. And at our annual International Bazaar, students, families, graduates, and staff come together to enjoy a day of culture and gastronomy, as well as to raise money for our charity partners.

Through our exclusive collaboration with UNICEF, your child will learn about the challenges facing our planet – and take action to address them. Our students investigate the UN Global Goals and the Rights of the Child agendas on our Global Campus platform. They also develop inspiring solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems by taking part in the UNICEF Global Challenge. Joining our Model United Nations encourages them to think and act like world-changers, too.

Our expedition to the Nord Anglia centre in Arusha, Tanzania, is the adventure of a lifetime. Our students work with peers from across the world on vital community projects, learn about the environment, and understand the importance of sustainable development. A truly life-changing experience, our trip to Tanzania builds our students’ confidence, independence, and sense of social responsibility.
Following the world-renowned International Baccalaureate programme, your child will enjoy an exceptional education that inspires them to achieve more than they ever thought possible.
